hypothesis: Can ordinary local code block complete outbound capsules containing common credential formats while allowing benign hashes, identifiers, placeholders and public keys?

decision_contract.input: the complete serialized capsule immediately before network transport
decision_contract.secret_found: BLOCK the whole capsule; emit only a receipt containing status=blocked and detector category
never_emit: a prefix or suffix of the detected value
a masked copy of the detected value
decision_contract.scope_boundary: This gate detects credentials, not every form of personal or confidential information. Owner permission remains a separate required gate.

secret_families: password, token, secret or API-key assignment
hard_negatives: ordinary words such as token budget or password policy

test_sets.real_visible_codex_messages: scan locally; publish counts and categories only, never text or matches

success_gate.real_scan_privacy: no message text, match text, prefix or suffix in the public result

claim_boundary: A pass proves coverage only for the frozen credential families and examples. It does not prove that arbitrary private facts or unknown future credential formats are safe.
